checklist.why: Purpose stated; names Stepper (counts) and the Numpad run (sequences) instead
Don'ts give the alternatives, Stepper and the Numpad run
Label, box, value, unit, status region and note named; demo shows all
No variant claimed; the base field is used by piglet-processing.weight and give-ids
Default, empty, pressed, active, focus, warn, refused and corrected rendered; disabled ruled out with a reason
Box is 50px+ tall at 375px; no target below 48
Warn has a dot and words, refused is struck through, corrected carries a "was" note
No label length cap or long-label truncation example
aria-describedby, live value, focus ring, no gesture-only action
Raw px in CSS (1/2/3/6/8px), and the README lists no CSS variables
Visible label, persistent hint, refusal says why, no system keyboard
Does not say whether it is a component, variant or pattern; related parts named only in prose
Every state rendered at 375px, no overflow or clipping

variants.name: Value field (unit always)
findings: On the weight sheet the label "Weight (kg)" and the box unit "kg" say the unit twice

variants.name: Identifier readout (no unit), misuse
findings: The Tag field is a Measure with no unit, which its own README forbids (an ear tag is typed in the Numpad's readout)
A duplicate tag is drawn with tone "refused" (blocks), but Numpad rules a duplicate tag is a warning that still records

findings.text: Give IDs builds the ear-tag field as a Measure with no unit and marks a duplicate tag "refused", breaking both the Measure rule (no unit = not a Measure) and the Numpad rule (a duplicate tag warns and records).
findings.fix: Either add an "identifier" variant to Measure (mono, no unit, warn-only tone) and document it, or render the tag as the Numpad readout; switch the duplicate to tone "warn".

findings.text: The weight sheet says the unit twice: label "Weight (kg)" over a box that writes "kg".
findings.fix: Label the field "Litter weight" (or "Weight") and keep the unit only in the box; add a README line: the label never carries the unit.

findings.text: An optional Measure renders as a full 62px field ("Weight · Optional" on Give IDs), while the optional-input rule and farrowing use a collapsed "+ Litter weight" row.
findings.fix: Add a collapsed optional state: one row of label + "Optional" + an Add door, expanding to the box on tap (match the Photos header row).

findings.text: CSS uses raw px for borders, gaps and the unit gap, and the README lists no CSS variables.
findings.fix: Map 1/2/3/6/8px to existing tokens (caret-width, status-dot, space-key-gap) and add a CSS-variables list to the README.

findings.text: No label-length rule or long-label example; zh labels are untested in the preview.
findings.fix: State a label cap and add one long en and one zh label to the preview.

proposals.name: Measure · identifier (tag)
proposals.why: Give IDs needs a pad-set mono value with no unit and a warn-only duplicate tone; today it is a Measure that breaks its own rules

proposals.name: Measure · optional row (collapsed)
proposals.why: Optional values (litter weight, piglet weight) should be one row until opened, like Photos and farrowing's + Litter weight
